activities.title: Resolve Component Identity
activities.description: Normalize MPN to canonical key, resolve aliases/family variants/distributor PNs, upsert components and manufacturers (L1).

activities.title: Ingest Source Documents
activities.description: Dedup by sha256, store blobs, record provenance and revision chain, link documents to MPNs (L2).

activities.title: Extract Source Chunks
activities.description: Decompose documents into page/table chunks with evidence anchors, index into FTS5, mark stale on extractor upgrade (L3).

activities.title: Normalize Component Specs
activities.description: Write EAV spec values, pinout, packages with evidence refs and confidence; enforce verified-needs-evidence trigger (L4).

activities.title: Serve Knowledge Queries
activities.description: Answer spec_check/query/queue/completeness requests; record EDA asset mappings, app knowledge, usage footprints, sourcing snapshots; expose gaps and audit trail (L5-L8).
